answer: Each identity presents a 24-month rent ledger: bank-verified rent transfers, checked against the landlord's tax return, one ledger per identity, a relic no forger mints. A fake costs $14,400 at $600 a month plus 730 days. The cheapest cheat is a forged lease for $300, but it shows no bank transfers, a quartz-clear gap; a rented stranger's ledger costs $1,500 and fails the name match. Time cannot be bought: no ledger can be backdated past bank timestamps, so an attacker waits two years, like an opal formed only under years of pressure. One hundred fakes: $1,440,000 plus 73,000 days.
